title: TypeSafe: Confidence
summary: Confidence is derived from the probability distribution; the page's three-option approximation generalizes to the option-count relationship measured in this repository. Motivates CT01.

title: TypeSafe: How to build with TypeSafe
summary: Decomposes a tool-call trace and a phishing message into atomic questions and suggests reasoning-model ensembles for labels. Several of its trace checks are exact comparisons this collection moves into code. Motivates CT02, CT06, CT09, CT10.

title: TypeSafe: Jev 1.13 jaggedness
summary: Literal reading, math in code, state-side context rot, and non-guaranteed structural invariants such as a question and its negation. Motivates CT01, CT02, CT03, CT05, CT07, CT08, CT09.

title: TypeSafe: Smart home assistant demo
summary: A Noul detects a compound request, a language model splits it, and each command is re-evaluated. Motivates CT03 and CT04.

title: TypeSafe: Models
summary: English is the primary training language; other languages need testing and attention to confidence. Motivates CT05.

title: TypeSafe: Agent skill
summary: Recommends collaborative question editing and keeping questions and thresholds reviewable; the human-AI evaluation in this repository found nine overlapping contracts by hand. Motivates CT08.
